findings.summary: xtask/shard-timings.txt is not among the reading's deliverables
findings.evidence: A change outside the listed deliverables widens the scope.

findings.summary: The plan wrongly says criterion 2 cannot hold for ra4, and drops the 'at least one source' check for cards that are not stated
findings.evidence: ra4 has `sources: []` but cites `claims: ["c7", "c8"]` (rationales.json:62-63). Both claims carry a file source with a non-blank quote (claims.json:50-52 and 57-59). So every card, ra4 included, reaches at least one quoted source, through its own sources or through the claims it cites. The planned checker requires a source only for `stated` cards. An `evidenced` or `inferred` card with no sources and no claims would pass, so criterion 2 is only partly shown, and the plan says it is unmeetable when it is not. Fix: In rationale_problems, require every card to reach at least one source with a non-blank quote, on the card itself or on a claim it cites. Keep the stricter stated-card rule as the production copy. Remove the 'does not hold for ra4' wording from Decision 1, the demonstration and the test comment. Add a mutation in which ra4's `claims` are set to [] (or claims.json is passed as `[]`), and assert that ra4 is reported. Before that, assert the target text is present.

findings.summary: A claim id that a card cites but that is missing from claims.json is not reported
findings.evidence: stated_without_source (rules.rs:375-379) quietly skips cited claim ids that are not in the study. The planned copy does the same. A card could cite a claim that does not exist and still pass, as long as it has a quote of its own. Fix: Report every cited claim id that is missing from claims.json. This is cheap, and it makes the check through cited claims (see the major finding) trustworthy.

findings.summary: The copied rules will drift silently; the plan's mitigation does not stop that
findings.evidence: The mutation cases test the copy against the real data, not against rules.rs. If incomplete_card or stated_without_source changes, the copy will not notice. No test in crates/ runs the cap-study rules on studies/firstmate-work-handling except drain.rs:7278 in athena-cli, which goes through study_text. Fix: Keep the copy, but say in the module docs that it is a snapshot of the rules at rules.rs:368-394 and 419-432 with no link to them. Alternatively, name drain.rs:7278 as the production path that runs the real rules on this study.
findings.location: Risks, first item; Dependents, 'files the new test reads'

summary: I checked the plan against the snapshot using Read and Grep. Most of it holds up. buy_first.rs:176-231 is a sound model for the spec tests. measure_problem (hestia.rs:1219) accepts `status: not shown`. The README and athena-v0.md §15 have the strings the plan pins (README.md:322-324, athena-v0.md:1604-1613). The mirror rule really does need a line in shard-timings.txt (mirrors.rs:222-227), and the plan puts it at the right place (shard-timings.txt:53-54). Editing the requirements-map row is safe: strategy.rs parse_map reads only the first word of the status cell. The copied rules match rules.rs:368-394 and 419-432, and Provenance has exactly the values Stated, Evidenced and Inferred (records.rs:203-207). No other file names OLY-B-A3-02. One factual error matters, though. The plan says criterion 2 ("at least one source") cannot hold for ra4, so it weakens the checker to require sources only on stated cards. But ra4 cites claims c7 and c8, and both have quoted sources (claims.json:48-59). So every card can be required to reach a source, either its own or through the claims it cites. That would meet criterion 2 as written. Without it, an evidenced or inferred card with no sources and no claims would pass unnoticed. This needs a revision.
